spec.description: Free CPU, memory and local volume space per node, so a placement that fails on one resource while another looks healthy is visible in one row.

spec.title: Free capacity per node
spec.description: Every schedulable node in the pool, with all three resources side by side. Sort on any column to find the mismatch that blocks placement: a node with terabytes free and no CPU left cannot take anything. Nodes with no local storage leave the volume columns empty and are still valid CPU and memory capacity.
